description: This Go source file is part of a controller package that handles generating commit reports based on application configuration. It includes functions to generate reports, handle repositories, and write report files, specifically for comparing commit history between upstream and downstream branches.

methods.name: GenerateCommitReport
methods.description: Generates commit reports for each diff target specified in the application configuration.

methods.name: generateCommitReport
methods.description: Creates a CSV report comparing commits between upstream and downstream branches for a given diff target.

methods.name: filenameForTarget
methods.description: Constructs a filename for the report CSV based on the diff target and current timestamp.
